markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_Gravity_Dial
markers.note: Sets local gravity between 0.1 and 2.0 for a whole ring segment.

markers.name: INT_The_Drop
markers.note: Falls forever unless someone changes the dial while you are falling.

markers.name: INT_Anti_Grav_Boot_Locker
markers.note: Anti-Grav Boots — also the Gravity Arena minigame reward (Part II 41).

markers.name: INT_Orbital_Tram
markers.note: Circles the ring. Stops are on the outside of the ring.

markers.name: INT_The_Balance_Puzzle
markers.note: Two players on two plates, different masses, one bridge.

markers.name: INT_Fallen_Climber
markers.note: Their log describes a segment that is not on any map.

markers.name: INT_The_Inverted_Town
markers.note: Built on the underside. The residents consider you upside-down.

markers.name: INT_Ring_Fracture
markers.note: A missing segment. Crossing it needs the dial and a running start.
